# identity.User

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:catalog`. Do not edit. -->

A user profile (`users/{uid}`), created on the first GET /v1/me.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `identity.User` |
| Kind | `entity` |
| PII | `personal` |
| Tenancy scope | `user` |

## Fields

| Field | Required | PII | Description | UI |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `accessVersion` | yes | `none` | Bumped on every grant change; a newer value than the token's means stale claims. |  |
| `createdAt` | yes | `none` | When the user doc was created (UTC). |  |
| `displayName` | yes | `personal` | Name shown to other members; may be empty. |  |
| `email` | yes | `personal` | Email address of the Firebase Auth account. |  |
| `id` | yes | `personal` | Firebase Auth uid (document id). |  |
| `lastContext` | yes | `none` | Last organization, project and unit used. |  |
| `photoUrl` | no | `personal` | Profile photo URL. |  |
| `preferences` | yes | `personal` | Locale, time zone, currency, theme, notifications. |  |
| `status` | yes | `none` | `disabled` users hold no permission. |  |
| `updatedAt` | yes | `none` | When the user doc last changed (UTC). |  |
